name: The Seraph's Ledger
description: A personal bundle of small Vintage Story tweaks: a trader ledger with map waypoints, large storage containers, bulk inventory moves, Sort/Trash buttons, ice-cooled cellars, a builder's material swatch tool, barrel ingredient portions, an animal tally board and more. Ctrl+Shift+L toggles every feature. WARNING: do not load a world holding large containers without this mod installed - the game falls back to the vanilla 16-slot container and silently drops everything past slot 16 (vanilla behaviour, and the same for every mod that widens a container). The mod keeps a copy of large container contents in the savegame's own mod data as a safety net; /sl rescue lists and restores whatever a mod-less load trimmed off.
